This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER

This application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking following reliefs:
"(i) Call for the entire record in relation to the Crime No.0201/2022, at Police Station Bakal, District Katni registered on 19.08.2022,
(ii) Quash the FIR (Annexure A-1) regarding Crime No.0201/2022, at Police Station Bakal, District Katni under section 498A, 506 of IPC, and section 3, 4 and of Dowry provision act 1961 and be further pleased to quash the further proceeding in the aforesaid crime no.0201/2022.

(ii) (a) It therefore, prayed that charge sheet/final report (Annexure A-17) may kindly be quashed consequently further proceedings of regarding crime No.0201/2022 after filing the charge sheet/final report and entire RCT 5811/2022 may kindly be quashed.

(iii) Any other relief may also be granted as this Hon'ble Court may deems fit in the interest of justice."
2.

After arguing the matter at length, counsel for applicants seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this application with liberty to raise all possible defences, which may be available to the applicants in the trial.
3. With aforesaid liberty, application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(G.S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE SR*
